annotations.title: Link to watch a market for rule changes

description: Use when the user wants to be told, alerted or notified when a Polymarket or Kalshi market's rules, resolution source, end date or title change, or wants to watch, follow or track a market for rule edits. Returns a RulesWatch link that opens with that market ready to watch, what an alert covers, and the plan limits. It does not create a watch or change anything: the user opens the link and presses Watch. Needs the market's venue and id.

id.description: The market id. Polymarket: the number in the market's id, like 562802. Kalshi: the market ticker, like KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H25. A Polymarket or Kalshi link is not an id; search with the link instead.

venue.description: pm (or polymarket) for Polymarket, kalshi for Kalshi.
